description: This file defines an interface named RouteCollectorProxyInterface within the Slim framework, specifying methods for route collection, HTTP method routing, route grouping, and redirection.

classes.name: RouteCollectorProxyInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for proxying route collection functionalities in Slim Framework, including adding routes for various HTTP methods, route grouping, and redirection.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns the ResponseFactoryInterface used by the route collector proxy.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the callable resolver used within the route collector proxy.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the container associated with the route collector proxy, which could be null.

methods.name: getRouteCollector
methods.description: Returns the underlying RouteCollector instance being proxied.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base path for the route group.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for the route group, returning the proxy interface for chaining.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Adds a GET route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Adds a POST route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a PUT route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Adds a PATCH route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a DELETE route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Adds an OPTIONS route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Adds a route that matches any HTTP method with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a route with multiple methods for the specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a group of routes with a common pattern or callable.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a route that performs an HTTP redirect from one path to another, with optional status code.
